samples.name: prop-turnip-sprout
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference images are style guides only. Single game sprite for cozy medieval Slavic village. Two tiny round green seedling leaves at center, occupying about 5x4 pixels of the 16x16 canvas. No bulb. Strict 16x16 logical pixel grid, enlarged with every pixel a large flat square. Kenney Tiny Farm simplicity, 2-3 flat shades per material. Top-down south-facing three-quarter view. Fully transparent background, including around plant so bed soil stays visible. No soil, pot, shadow or scenery. Warm muted greens, purple and cream where bulb required. No gradients, antialiasing, haze, tiny veins, text, panels, multiple sprites, neon edge colors or black outlines.
